main.node: Search Existing Sheet Profile by Sender
Search Existing Supplier if No Email Profile

parameters.jsCode:
/**
 * n8n Code node — "Products to Create"
 * Mode: Run Once for All Items
 *
 * Emits one item per NEW product, for the Airtable create node that follows.
 *
 * These are products the catalogue has never seen. Until 2026-07-30 an offer
 * whose product did not match was parked for a human instead, on the reasoning
 * that auto-creating products is how a catalogue fills with near-duplicates.
 * That reasoning was right about the mechanism and wrong about the cost: it had
 * left 1,103 of 1,728 live offers with no product link, which is a stoppage
 * rather than a safeguard. Every record created here carries
 * Status = "Needs Review" so the duplicates stay findable and can be merged.
 *
 * Deduplicated in 04 by Product Key, so two rows of the same new SKU in one
 * file produce one product, not two.
 *
 * Emitted FLAT rather than wrapped in { fields: ... } — the Airtable node's
 * "Map Automatically" mode reads the item's top-level keys as column names.
 */

const products = [];

for (const item of $('Build Airtable Payload').all()) {
  for (const record of item.json.productsToCreate || []) {
    products.push({ json: record.fields || record });
  }
}

return products;

parameters.text:
=Extract every distinct product offer from this supplier email. This is a first-time sender with no known column layout, so read the raw content directly.

Subject: {{ $('Resolve Body Profile').all()[$itemIndex].json.subject }}
Sender: {{ $('Resolve Body Profile').all()[$itemIndex].json.fromAddress }}

Prose/context (may contain terms like Incoterm, warehouse, lead time, MOQ that apply to ALL offers below unless a line overrides them):
{{ $('Resolve Body Profile').all()[$itemIndex].json.prose }}

Raw content blocks:
{{ JSON.stringify($('Resolve Body Profile').all()[$itemIndex].json.blocks) }}

Return one entry per distinct product/price combination. Use these exact enum values where applicable:
- currency: EUR, USD, GBP, AED, SGD, Other
- unitType: Bottle, Can, Jar, Pack, Piece, Other
- priceType: Per Case, Per Bottle, Per Can, Per Piece, Per Pack, Per Jar
- bondStatus: Bonded, T1, T2, Duty Paid, On Floor, Other
- incoterm: EXW, FCA, FOB, CFR, CIF, DAP, DDP, Other
- category: Beer, Spirits, Champagne, Grocery, Confectionery, Toiletries, Soft Drinks, Other FMCG

If a field is genuinely not stated anywhere, leave it blank/null rather than guessing. Never invent a price or product name.
